def compute_k10_variance(wrapper, kv_cache, pad_masks):
    """Sum of per-DOF variance across K=10 samples on first chunk step (6D pose)."""
    samples = wrapper.generate_k_samples_batched(kv_cache, pad_masks, K=10)
    variance = samples[0, :, 0, :CORRECTION_DIM].var(dim=0).sum().item()
    return variance


def calibrate(args):
    set_seed(args.seed)
    device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")

    print(f"[fmvd] Loading SmolVLA from {args.smolvla_path}...")
    wrapper = SmolVLAWrapper(args.smolvla_path, device=str(device))
    num_steps = wrapper.config.num_steps
    print(f"[fmvd] num_steps={num_steps}, chunk_size={wrapper.config.chunk_size}")

    print(f"[fmvd] Loading LIBERO {args.benchmark} environments...")
    task_envs = load_libero_env(args.benchmark)
    print(f"[fmvd] {len(task_envs)} tasks loaded.")

    per_step_data = []
    total_steps = 0
    t0 = time.time()

    for ti, task_info in enumerate(task_envs):
        task_name = task_info["task_name"]
        task_desc = task_info["task_description"]
        env = task_info["env"]
        init_states = task_info["init_states"]

        for ep in range(args.n_episodes):
            init_state = init_states[ep % len(init_states)]
            env.reset()
            obs = env.set_init_state(init_state)
            for _ in range(5):
                obs, _, _, _ = env.step(np.zeros(7))

            episode_success = False
            ep_start_idx = len(per_step_data)

            for step in range(args.max_steps):
                agentview = obs["agentview_image"]
                eye_in_hand = obs.get("robot0_eye_in_hand_image", None)
                robot_state = get_robot_state(obs)

                imgs, img_masks, lt, lm, state = wrapper.preprocess_obs(
                    agentview, task_desc, robot_state, eye_in_hand
                )
                obs_feat, kv_cache, pad_masks = wrapper.encode_prefix(
                    imgs, img_masks, lt, lm, state
                )

                action_k1, fmvd = generate_k1_with_fmvd(wrapper, kv_cache, pad_masks)
                k10_var = compute_k10_variance(wrapper, kv_cache, pad_masks)

                per_step_data.append({
                    "step": total_steps,
                    "task": task_name,
                    "episode": ep,
                    "env_step": step,
                    "fmvd": round(fmvd, 6),
                    "k10_variance": round(k10_var, 6),
                    "episode_success": None,
                })
                total_steps += 1

                action_7d = action_k1[0, 0].cpu().numpy()
                obs, reward, done, info = env.step(action_7d)

                if done or info.get("success", False):
                    episode_success = True
                    break

            for i in range(ep_start_idx, len(per_step_data)):
                per_step_data[i]["episode_success"] = episode_success

            elapsed = time.time() - t0
            print(f"  [{task_name}] ep {ep+1}/{args.n_episodes}: "
                  f"{'OK' if episode_success else 'FAIL'} ({step+1} steps) "
                  f"| total={total_steps} | {elapsed:.0f}s")

        env.close()

    fmvd_vals = np.array([d["fmvd"] for d in per_step_data])
    k10_vals = np.array([d["k10_variance"] for d in per_step_data])

    fmvd_pcts = np.percentile(fmvd_vals, [25, 50, 75, 90])

    result = {
        "config": {
            "benchmark": args.benchmark,
            "n_episodes": args.n_episodes,
            "seed": args.seed,
            "n_steps_collected": total_steps,
            "num_ode_steps": num_steps,
        },
        "statistics": {
            "fmvd_mean": round(float(fmvd_vals.mean()), 6),
            "fmvd_std": round(float(fmvd_vals.std()), 6),
            "fmvd_percentiles": {
                "P25": round(float(fmvd_pcts[0]), 6),
                "P50": round(float(fmvd_pcts[1]), 6),
                "P75": round(float(fmvd_pcts[2]), 6),
                "P90": round(float(fmvd_pcts[3]), 6),
            },
            "k10_variance_mean": round(float(k10_vals.mean()), 6),
            "k10_variance_std": round(float(k10_vals.std()), 6),
            "spearman_rho": round(float(rho), 6),
            "spearman_pvalue": float(pvalue),
        },
        "per_step_data": per_step_data,
    }

    go = abs(rho) > 0.3
    print(f"\n=== FMVD Calibration Results ===")
    print(f"Steps collected: {total_steps}")
    print(f"FMVD: mean={fmvd_vals.mean():.4f} std={fmvd_vals.std():.4f} "
          f"[P25={fmvd_pcts[0]:.4f} P50={fmvd_pcts[1]:.4f} "
          f"P75={fmvd_pcts[2]:.4f} P90={fmvd_pcts[3]:.4f}]")
    print(f"K=10 Variance: mean={k10_vals.mean():.4f} std={k10_vals.std():.4f}")
    print(f"Spearman rho(FMVD, K10_var) = {rho:.4f} (p={pvalue:.2e})")
    print(f"GO/NO-GO: {'GO' if go else 'NO-GO'} (threshold: rho > 0.3)")

    out_path = Path(args.output)
    out_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    out_path.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2))
    print(f"[fmvd] Results saved to {args.output}")

    return result


def main():
    signal.signal(signal.SIGSEGV, lambda s, f: (print(f"[fmvd] FATAL: signal {s}"), sys.exit(139)))
    args = parse_args()
    print(f"[fmvd] args: {vars(args)}")
    calibrate(args)
    sys.exit(0)
